about: The class a review shows, from its classification text and its tags: normalizeReviewClassification (smallVariantSearch.ts) wherever the family page shows a small-variant review's class, review_class_label (backend review_pg_utils.py) in the Variant Explorer, the classification filters and the family CSV export. smallVariantSearch.test.ts, smallVariantResultUtils.test.ts, the table, card and review dialog tests and backend test_acmg_frontend_parity.py read these cases, so they read a review alike. An empty 'shown' is no class.
